events.title: Deskpot is joining 'Companion Falls For You'!
events.summary: My fellow green thumbs,Deskpot is joining 'Companion Falls For You', a Steam event aimed towards desktop companion games. Because in these interesting times, we all need some whimsy in our lives. We need critters, widgets, and personified plant pots to keep us company.'Companion Falls For You' is hosted by Mister Morris Games. You might know him as the developer of 'Rusty's Retirement'. events.title: Public Playtest is now live!
events.summary: Hi everyone!The public playtest for Deskpot is now live! You can join the playtest via the Deskpot store page. The game is finishing up active development, so some plants will still have art placeholders.If you are already part of the playtest and have any bugs or feedback you'd like to share, please join the Discord or send me a mail at roaringluck@gmail.com!If you are part of the press or are a content creator who'd like to try out Deskpot, you can also reach out to me via the above pathways,
